author: Nelev
body:
## Summary

Two related pieces of the API: a working `POST /messages` endpoint, and the chunking/embedding groundwork the RAG pipeline needs.

## `POST /messages`

The scaffolded `GET /items/{item_id}` stub was replaced by a route that did not import. Four defects:

- `from model import MessageRequest` — `model/__init__.py` never exported it (`ImportError` at startup)
- `model/message-request.py` — a hyphen is not legal in a module name, so it was unimportable regardless
- `MessageRequest` was a plain class, not a `BaseModel`, so FastAPI could neither validate it nor emit an OpenAPI schema
- the handler returned `item_id`, which was never declared as a parameter (`NameError` per request)

The path parameter was copy-paste residue from the stub and had no meaning on a create, so it is gone. Schemas live in a new `schema` package rather than `model`, whose `__init__` feeds `Base.metadata` to Alembic autogenerate — wire formats and table definitions change for different reasons.

## RAG pipeline

`rag_pipeline/chunks.py` flattens `medical_history.json` into one chunk per clinical record — 21 for the sample patient — rather than one vector for the whole document, which would match every query weakly and none precisely. Each chunk repeats the patient identity, because retrieval hands the model a chunk with no surrounding context, and renders fields as prose rather than JSON, since prose is what the embedding model is trained on. `chunk_id` is deterministic so re-runs upsert instead of duplicating.

`get_embeddings_batch` sends all chunks in one request instead of one per chunk, and re-sorts the response by its `index` field — a reordered response would otherwise silently mispair every chunk with the wrong vector, surfacing only as inexplicably poor retrieval.

Also declares `python-dotenv`, which was resolving only transitively via `pydantic-settings`, and drops a `known-first-party = ["app"]` ruff entry naming a package that no longer exists.

## Testing

- `ruff check .` clean across the package
- `POST /messages` exercised via `TestClient`: valid body → 200; missing field → 422; empty string → 422
- Chunker run against the real JSON: 21 chunks, all `chunk_id`s unique, UTF-8 preserved (`µ` in dose strings survives as U+00B5)
- `embeddings.py` executed top to bottom with `openai` stubbed: one API call carrying 21 string inputs, 21 vectors returned, correctly ordered

**Not verified:** the live OpenRouter call. The sandbox blocked outbound requests carrying the record text, so the real vector dimension is unconfirmed, as is whether OpenRouter serves `/embeddings` at all — its compatibility surface has historically covered chat completions only. If it does not, `const.py` is the single place to repoint.

## Notes for review

- `rag_pipeline/embeddings.py` runs its chunk-and-embed block at module scope, so importing it fires a billable API call. Fine as a script; wants a `__main__` guard before anything else imports it.
- Three records in `medical_history.json` predate the patient's DOB (`ep_01` and two diagnoses dated 1986-11-02 against a DOB of 1987-12-07, describing the patient at age 6). Since chunks embed both dates as text, any question about timing will retrieve contradictory context. Data fix, not a pipeline one.
- Unrelated working-tree changes in `medas-ui/` were deliberately left out of this branch.
